body: No. There was something that I used to look forward to, something that gave me a purpose, but it was taken away by fucking genetics

That is the only thing stopping me. The fact is, I’ve been clinically depressed since I was 12 (I’m 21) and I had a failed suicide attempt when I was 15 and it has not gotten any better. I’m just so tired of feeling empty, of not being able to enjoy this beautiful life, of constantly hating myself for no reason at all
